I’ll inspect the repository instructions, add regression tests first, then implement the parameters and run the required gates. I’ll also test the single commit against upstream in scratch worktrees without pushing or contacting Zulip.The baseline suite passed: 296 tests passed and 1 skipped. The new tests failed as expected before implementation. I’ll extend `edit_message` rather than add `move_topic`: both use the same endpoint, and the optional fields also allow content and topic changes in one request.The commit passes all required Node 22.23.3 gates. The suite now has 314 passing tests and 1 skipped.

Scratch cherry-picks confirm it applies cleanly to upstream + #36 without #37. Bare upstream conflicts in `src/tool-runtime.ts` and `test/editMessage.test.ts`, which depend on #36’s request/error handling and test fixture.
